content: Hexagonal (ports and adapters): system split into core, ports (interfaces defined inside the core stating what it needs from outside), and adapters (implementations injected at runtime via DI/registry); abstraction increases toward the core, which knows only interfaces. Recommended hybrid for Dark Factory: layered core (orchestrator -> workflow -> role executor) with hexagonal boundaries for CodingWorker, VersionControl, Persistence repositories, and Integration (TaskSource/HumanChannel/PublishTarget) ports. New runtimes/integrations (Copilot, Hermes, later Jira/Confluence) are added as adapters registered in config without touching core. Enforce forbidden import edges (workers must not import orchestrator/workflows/persistence) with a tool like import-linter in CI. Python precedent: Bob Gregory ports-and-adapters + command handler.
